parameters.query:
SELECT json_agg(r) as rules FROM brand_rules r;
SELECT json_agg(f) as facts FROM product_facts f;

messageValues.message:
=You are a Brand Compliance Auditor. Evaluate the following draft content against our corporate brand rules.

{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.text }}

Brand Rules:
{{ JSON.stringify($('Execute a SQL query').item.json) }}

Return a JSON object with:
- "brand_score": an integer from 0 to 100 based on compliance.
- "summary": a short paragraph summarizing any violations or confirming compliance.
